name: VoidkitEssentials
description:
Everything the average server needs in the way of commands.

Homes, warps, spawn, back, TPA (with clickable accept/deny buttons), admin tools (fly / god / heal / feed / speed / vanish / hat / enderchest / invsee) and player/server info lookup.

It also takes over the vanilla commands players type most often and gives them short aliases (/day /night /sun /rain /freeze /gr /diff /gm), forwarding them to vanilla rather than reimplementing them.

This jar also contains the permission and economy modules - they are not separate mods and there is nothing else to download. Their data still lives in voidkit/perm/ and voidkit/economy/.

Every module here can be toggled individually via the `features` config.
Requires voidkit_core. Server-side only.
